set.body:
Scope
Establish external validity on directional gaze data before choosing a default engine.

Acceptance criteria
- Repeated viewing provides a strong local-order positive control.
- Looking-at-nothing or imagery provides contraction, partial replay, and background-gaze tests.
- Negative controls include within-participant wrong items, shuffled order at fixed coordinates, and generic participant gaze.
- Participant and item effects, warp/background fitting, calibration, and model selection are fully cross-fitted.
- Candidate sampling, exclusions, preprocessing, fixation detector, units, licenses, and data provenance are recorded.
- Report information gain, log loss, calibration uncertainty, identification, matched-FPR power, diagnostic recovery where possible, and sensitivity analyses.
- Compare Transport, Replay, registered density, calibrated MultiMatch, and elastic matching under the same evaluation contract.
- Results support a bounded default-engine decision or explicitly record that neither engine has earned default status.
set.title: GW-7 Run held-out real positive and negative controls
